cards.key_message: In 20 days, this went from strikes to energy infrastructure war.

items.text: 900 strikes in 12 hours. Khamenei killed. Iran retaliates — 500+ missiles, 2,000 drones.
Traffic drops 70%. Maersk, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd suspend all transits.
Strait officially closed. Only Chinese vessels permitted passage.
Iran lays naval mines. US sinks 16 minelayers. 21 attacks on merchant ships.
First day of zero crossings. 850 tankers stranded globally.
Shah gas field + Fujairah hit. Larijani killed. Israel invades Lebanon.
South Pars struck. Iran hits Ras Laffan, Ras Tanura. Energy infrastructure war begins.
US bunker busters on Hormuz. Trump threatens to 'massively blow up' South Pars.

data.insight: Phase 1 closed the strait. Phase 2 is destroying the infrastructure behind it. Even when the strait reopens, the loading terminals need months of repair.
